intro: The detective has vanished, and the Irregulars have taken to leaving his notes pinned around the parlour wall, each one pinned with the same slanting thumbtack, each one bearing a single smudge where a careful hand paused too long over one word. The violin leans against the mantelpiece, its one retuned string humming faintly in the draught from the window, and nobody has touched the pipes in the drawer for a week. The landlady says the children have been sitting in a circle each evening, reading the notes aloud and arguing over which word was meant, as if the detective left them there on purpose, as if each page had been copied by someone who never made the same slip twice but always made the same slip once.
echo: Means and opportunity are easy. The hard part is why.

meta.title: Meta: 221B, Upstairs
meta.flavor: Nothing reached Baker Street undamaged. The damage, though, was remarkably consistent.
hints: Did every answer come out clean the first time? Each had exactly one wrong letter. Did you keep them?
